name: Beefy
description: Beefy automates yield farming to make DeFi easy, safe and efficient for all. By autocompounding your tokens, Beefy unlocks higher returns so you earn more of what you love.

methodology.Fees: 9.5% of each harvest is charged as a performance fee
methodology.Revenue: All fees except for 0.5% to strategist and variable harvest() call fee are revenue
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 36% of revenue is distributed to holders who stake
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 64% of revenue is distributed to the treasury
